column3: NKJV has “be courteous,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “be humble.”
NKJV has “sanctify the Lord God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “sanctify Christ as Lord.”
NKJV has “bring us to God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “bring you to God.”
NKJV has “now saves us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “now saves you.”
